title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Integrate Business Central with SharePoint
summary: This blog series covers integrating Dynamics 365 Business Central with SharePoint for document management, including storing attachments externally, uploading and importing files via Graph API, saving reports to SharePoint, managing attachments, and previewing various file types within Business Central without customization.
key_points: Business Central 2026 wave 1 (BC28) supports storing document attachments outside the database without customization
Files can be uploaded to and imported from SharePoint document libraries using AL code with Graph API
Reports can be saved directly to SharePoint both manually and automatically via AL integration
External attachment storage in SharePoint preserves Business Central database capacity
Multiple file types (PDF, JPG, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, CSV, MP4) can be previewed within Business Central without JavaScript control add-ins
features: SharePoint file upload via Graph API
SharePoint file import via Graph API

quotes.text: How to import/read files from SharePoint (document library) to Business Central via AL (Graph API)
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows developers can integrate SharePoint content into Business Central using standard Graph API methods
